title: Control Variate Score Matching for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.20003v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sampling from unnormalized probability densities is a pervasive challenge across the computational and physical sciences. Diffusion models provide a powerful generative framework for this task, but their success relies on accurately estimating the score of the perturbed target distribution. Current approaches face a dichotomy between two standard estimation methods: the Denoising Score Identity (DSI) requires data samples and exhibits high variance at low noise levels, whereas the Target Score Identity (TSI) relies on the energy function and suffers from diverging variance at high noise levels. In this work, we reconcile both approaches by introducing the Control Variate Score Identity (CVSI), an unbiased estimator with an analytically optimal, state- and time-dependent control coefficient that theoretically minimizes variance over the entire diffusion process. translated_title: 扩散模型的控制变量得分匹配
translated_abstract: 从非归一化概率密度中采样是计算科学和物理科学中普遍存在的挑战。扩散模型为这一任务提供了强大的生成框架，但其成功依赖于对扰动目标分布的得分进行准确估计。当前方法面临两种标准估计方法之间的两难困境：去噪得分恒等式（DSI）需要数据样本，且在低噪声水平下方差较高；而目标得分恒等式（TSI）依赖于能量函数，在高噪声水平下方差会发散。在本工作中，我们通过引入控制变量得分恒等式（CVSI）来调和这两种方法，这是一种无偏估计器，具有解析最优的、依赖于状态和时间的控制系数，理论上能够在整个扩散过程中最小化方差。CVSI作为一种鲁棒的即插即用估计器，能够显著提升……
tldr: 本文提出控制变量得分恒等式（CVSI），一种具有解析最优、依赖状态与时间的控制系数的无偏得分估计器，通过调和去噪得分恒等式与目标得分恒等式，在理论上于整个扩散过程中最小化方差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Control Variate Score Identity (CVSI), an unbiased score estimator with an analytically optimal, state- and time-dependent control coefficient, which reconciles the DSI and TSI approaches and theoretically minimizes variance over the entire diffusion process.
